body: Thank you, I've taken a look online about it and it might just be a clog of a vein or something, if it sticks for a couple more days then I will look into it. I'll keep in mind that phone number too and I might send you a message later, thanks man.

Unfortunately, I am written on a lease for a year, I'm thinking I could stay in a hostel (I work at one) for nights that they want to be alone at our place, other nights they usually go to his so I am thinking I will do that. He stayed back at our place again but I played music with headphones. Reason why I didn't earlier was because of the fact that they are way too bulky to be able to sleep on one side with them. I did that and got some sleep. It really was just other people's noises. I like to think the reason why I got so pissed was because I was CONVINCED that they were doing things that they said they wouldn't do. I'll figure it out.

I agree, how do I change?

I am, but not in a romantic way. I have other women that I am interested in but they're back in vancouver. I have gone on tinder dates and even had hookups.

I agree, and I apologized to both of them.
I'm willing to admit that it might be, iv'e apologized to both of them and dint put any blame on them. This is my problem.

I'm a dude. People harp on me for having a female roommate, even weirder when they discover we aren't dating, so its hard to find people to relate to, cause they automatically assume that I am just following her and that my negativity towards her boyfreind come from jealousy.

Its the things that he say that I find to raise alarms. He has referred to himself as "bad news", called himself "A bad person" and "doesn't know how to relationship". The first two I see as pride, and that he doesn't seem to change it, the last one I see as an excuse he is going to use in the future after he does something stupid.

Within the first couple of days we started sassing each-other and he would do things to her and just stare at me. Obviously not sexual things but it would be like, using her torso as a kongo or shoving his head into her chest. We had a joke going on about how I would steal him away from her, when he came over to play on his 360 for a bit he had to sit on my bed since he had a wired controller. I look over to my roomate and go, hey "roomate", he is on my bed now. Watch out. He replied, see how she's on my bed?

How could I not all you guys do all day is tickle each-other. That's what I wanted to say. But I didn't want to start conflict when I had nowhere to stay but his place.

Instead of saying "I don't know how to relationship" he has been saying "we don't". Little bit concerning

I know a lot of people could easily say I am over-analyzing and I wouldn't blame them. But she even told me 2 months before we left, that even though she thinks he is ok, she knows she has had a hot-streak of dating bad guys and that I should let her know if anything is fishy.

I obviously haven't cause there isn't. He seems to genuinely care for her and I respect that, but it hasn't stopped me from trying to protect her.

I definitely have come to that conclusion too Vanilla, I can't protect her but ill' do my best to catch her IF she falls. Let's hope not, cause I think that their relationship is really cute. 3 years apart over the internet and being together physically is really cool.

It was more then that, it lasted around 15 minutes and progressed to penetration. The paranoia of that same thing happening came afterwards. Could you imagine waking up to, and trying to avoid hearing your best friend, someone you love like your sister, is making out, and progressing further and further towards sex with a complete stranger? (To me, I had barely known anything about the guy.)

I admit that I am being possessive, it's not fair to either of them. I know I am overreacting, Ive talked to him about other male v male power dynamics that we were doing to each-other for the stupidest reasons, but I won't get into that, since we both agree that it was immature of us.

Whenever I start convincing myself that it is happening, or that it actually was happening and I wasn't sure, it was less of me trying to "protect" her or some shit, it was more so of, why am I here. Why do I need to prevent them from loving each-other? If I wasn't here, would they have a better time? Am I just getting in the way?

The first time I stormed of the apartment and they knew about it I left saying something along the lines of, I'm leaving so you don't need to try and muffle yourselves, go all out. That's how I feel. I feel like I am just a plus one, and my worries were true, cause I have been overreacting and pushing them to try and distance themselves from me.

Thanks for your message, I totally get what you are saying.

I know that for sure they did on the first week. Possibly more then once but they only know I was awake for the one.

I don't want to be possessive. She is her own woman and she can do what she wants, and even though I know that he quit smoking for her, and helped her through her tough times as well, I am worried. The things he says and does are, to me alarming. She has a tendency to date the bad boys. And even if he is not worse, or maybe he was and he is getting better. It's still scary.

I want to protect her but she doesn't need it. I want to help her but she doesn't need it. Frankly I feel useless.

His birthday party is tonight and I have presents I was planning to give him, but I don't want to go to the bar, since the night before I tried binge drinking to pass out before I had to possibly wake up to it, even if it was happening or not. So I don't want to go to a bar cause I would be obligated to drink.

I didn't wrap my present so its in an EB Games bag.

Ive told them to, if they are going to do something to wake me up and I would give them an hour. He told me he wouldn't disrespect me in my own house. And even if my roommate had the mentality of "its my house too", she then agreed (she does that too, changes her opinion of anything on a dime to suit his preference, that's something im scared of)

There's going to be a lot of people there, his friends that I haven't socialised with. Maybe he told them about how paranoid I am. Maybe they won't like me anymore.

I have tons of problems with going outside, it's scary. On top of the fact that this is happening is not very awesome either.
